name: shifaa
description: SHIFAA Egyptian integrated digital health platform

scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages services tests tools .github package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml turbo.json compose.yml .prettierrc.json docs/TEAM-INSTALLATION-CHECKLIST.md infra/runbooks/identity-onboarding.md specs/001-identity-onboarding
scripts.test:a11y: pnpm --filter @shifaa/design-system test && pnpm --filter @shifaa/i18n test && pnpm --filter @shifaa/patient test && pnpm --filter @shifaa/admin test
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm test:a11y && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm contracts:check && pnpm architecture:check && pnpm secrets:check && pnpm dependencies:check && docker compose config --quiet && docker compose up -d --wait postgres && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:test && pnpm db:rls-test
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U shifaa_owner -d shifaa -f /workspace/infra/db/migrations/001_identity_onboarding.sql
scripts.db:test: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U shifaa_owner -d shifaa -f /workspace/infra/db/tests/identity-onboarding-schema.sql
scripts.db:rls-test: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U shifaa_owner -d shifaa -f /workspace/infra/db/tests/identity-onboarding-rls.sql
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait postgres && pnpm db:migrate
scripts.contracts:check: node tools/verify-contracts.mjs && pnpm --filter @shifaa/contracts test && pnpm --filter @shifaa/api-client test
scripts.dependencies:check: pnpm peers check && pnpm audit --audit-level high --ignore-unfixable && pnpm --filter @shifaa/patient exec expo install --check
